# Reading list {#sec-reading-list .unnumbered}

This table gathers, in one place, the reading named at the end of each chapter,
so the whole plan can be seen at a glance. Page numbers are to the editions
below; the per-chapter reading paragraphs give the same references with a little
more context.

**Core texts.** **Jøsang** - A. Jøsang, *Cybersecurity: Technology and
Governance* (Springer, 2025). **E&W** - Edwards & Weaver, *The Cybersecurity
Guide to Governance, Risk, and Compliance* (Wiley, 2024).
